brief: Three proposals. One board meeting. 45 minutes to make the call.
brief_id: Tiga proposal. Satu rapat dewan. 45 menit untuk mengambil keputusan.

scenes.text: Boardroom. Alex reads three thick proposals, one after another.

id.text: Ruang boardroom. Alex membaca tiga proposal tebal, satu per satu.

scenes.text: Three proposals from three different teams. All with different budget requests. Board meeting in 45 minutes. I have to make a decision now.

id.text: Tiga proposal dari tiga tim berbeda. Budget request berbeda semua. Board meeting 45 menit lagi. Saya harus buat keputusan sekarang.

scenes.text: Alex, for a situation like this — try using Bob. He can synthesise all of this into an executive summary plus a trade-off analysis.

id.text: Pak Alex, untuk kasus seperti ini — coba pakai Bob. Dia bisa synthesize semua ini jadi executive summary plus trade-off analysis.

scenes.text: An AI can help me make decisions?

id.text: AI bisa bantu saya buat keputusan?

scenes.text: Not replacing your decision — but giving you clarity, faster.

id.text: Bukan menggantikan keputusan Anda — tapi memberi Anda clarity yang lebih cepat.

scenes.problem: Three proposals from three teams — different scopes, different budgets. Board meeting in 45 minutes. You need a clear summary of what each proposes before you can decide.

id.problem: Tiga proposal dari tiga tim — cakupan berbeda, anggaran berbeda. Board meeting 45 menit lagi. Butuh ringkasan yang jelas dari masing-masing proposal sebelum bisa memutuskan.

options.label: Ask Bob to summarise all three proposals
options.bobResponse:
Executive Summary — 3 Proposals.

**Proposal A — AI Customer Support Platform**
Team: Product + Engineering | Budget: $280,000
Scope: Deploy AI chatbot to handle Tier-1 support tickets. Estimated 40% reduction in support costs. Timeline: 6 months.
Risk: Integration complexity with legacy CRM (rated medium).

**Proposal B — Data Analytics Modernisation**
Team: Data + IT | Budget: $195,000
Scope: Migrate reporting stack to watsonx.data. Real-time dashboards for all BUs. Timeline: 4 months.
Risk: Data migration downtime (rated low — phased approach).

**Proposal C — AI Governance Framework**
Team: IT + Legal | Budget: $85,000
Scope: Policy documentation, access management, compliance audit trail. Timeline: 2 months.
Risk: Minimal — documentation-only initiative.

Ready for trade-off analysis.
options.bobFollowUp: Generate trade-off analysis and executive brief
options.outcome: Executive Brief Ready ✓  All three proposals summarised and compared. Board-ready.

id_text.label: Minta Bob meringkas ketiga proposal
id_text.bobResponse:
Ringkasan Eksekutif — 3 Proposal.

**Proposal A — Platform Dukungan Pelanggan AI**
Tim: Produk + Engineering | Anggaran: $280.000
Cakupan: Deploy chatbot AI untuk menangani tiket dukungan Tier-1. Estimasi pengurangan biaya dukungan 40%. Timeline: 6 bulan.
Risiko: Kompleksitas integrasi dengan CRM lama (dinilai sedang).

**Proposal B — Modernisasi Analitik Data**
Tim: Data + IT | Anggaran: $195.000
Cakupan: Migrasi stack pelaporan ke watsonx.data. Dashboard real-time untuk semua BU. Timeline: 4 bulan.
Risiko: Downtime migrasi data (dinilai rendah — pendekatan bertahap).

**Proposal C — Kerangka AI Governance**
Tim: IT + Legal | Anggaran: $85.000
Cakupan: Dokumentasi policy, manajemen akses, audit trail kepatuhan. Timeline: 2 bulan.
Risiko: Minimal — hanya inisiatif dokumentasi.

Siap untuk analisis trade-off.
id_text.bobFollowUp: Hasilkan analisis trade-off dan executive brief
id_text.outcome: Executive Brief Ready ✓  Ketiga proposal diringkas dan dibandingkan. Siap untuk board.

options.label: Read all three proposals and draft the summary manually
options.outcome: Summary written for two proposals. No time for the third before the meeting.

id_text.label: Baca ketiga proposal dan buat ringkasan secara manual
id_text.outcome: Ringkasan ditulis untuk dua proposal. Tidak ada waktu untuk yang ketiga sebelum meeting.

options.label: Walk into the meeting with the raw proposals and decide on the spot
options.outcome: Board asks questions you can't answer quickly. Decision delayed by two weeks.

id_text.label: Masuk meeting dengan proposal mentah dan putuskan di tempat
id_text.outcome: Board mengajukan pertanyaan yang tidak bisa dijawab cepat. Keputusan ditunda dua minggu.

scenes.text: Good. Now I need a recommendation on which to prioritise — and a draft decision document for the board.

id.text: Bagus. Sekarang saya butuh rekomendasi mana yang harus diprioritaskan — dan draft keputusan untuk board.

scenes.problem: Three proposals summarised. Now you need a prioritisation recommendation and a draft decision document for the board, in the next 15 minutes.

id.problem: Tiga proposal sudah diringkas. Sekarang butuh rekomendasi prioritas dan draft keputusan untuk board, dalam 15 menit ke depan.

options.label: Ask Bob to generate the trade-off matrix and draft the decision
options.bobResponse:
Trade-off Matrix + Draft Decision.

| Criteria         | Proposal A | Proposal B | Proposal C |
|------------------|-----------|-----------|------------|
| Strategic impact | High      | High      | Medium     |
| Budget           | $280K     | $195K     | $85K       |
| Time to value    | 6 months  | 4 months  | 2 months   |
| Risk             | Medium    | Low       | Minimal    |

**Recommended sequencing:**
1. Proposal C first (2 months, minimal risk — establishes governance foundation)
2. Proposal B second (4 months — builds data infrastructure)
3. Proposal A third (6 months — highest ROI but depends on B's data layer)

**Draft decision for board:**
"We recommend approving all three proposals in sequence (C → B → A), with a combined budget of $560,000 over 12 months. This sequence minimises risk and ensures each initiative builds on the previous one."

Review and sign off.
options.bobFollowUp: Finalise and present to the board
options.outcome: Executive Brief Ready ✓  Board approves the sequenced plan unanimously.

id_text.label: Minta Bob menghasilkan trade-off matrix dan draft keputusan
id_text.bobResponse:
Trade-off Matrix + Draft Keputusan.

| Kriteria          | Proposal A | Proposal B | Proposal C |
|-------------------|-----------|-----------|------------|
| Dampak strategis  | Tinggi    | Tinggi    | Sedang     |
| Anggaran          | $280K     | $195K     | $85K       |
| Waktu ke nilai    | 6 bulan   | 4 bulan   | 2 bulan    |
| Risiko            | Sedang    | Rendah    | Minimal    |

**Urutan yang direkomendasikan:**
1. Proposal C dulu (2 bulan, risiko minimal — menetapkan fondasi governance)
2. Proposal B kedua (4 bulan — membangun infrastruktur data)
3. Proposal A ketiga (6 bulan — ROI tertinggi tapi bergantung pada lapisan data B)

**Draft keputusan untuk board:**
"Kami merekomendasikan menyetujui ketiga proposal secara berurutan (C → B → A), dengan anggaran gabungan $560.000 selama 12 bulan. Urutan ini meminimalkan risiko dan memastikan setiap inisiatif dibangun di atas yang sebelumnya."

Tinjau dan tanda tangani.
id_text.outcome: Executive Brief Ready ✓  Board menyetujui rencana berurutan dengan suara bulat.

options.label: Manually compare the proposals and write the decision document
options.outcome: Decision drafted. No formal trade-off matrix — board asks for more analysis.

id_text.label: Bandingkan proposal secara manual dan tulis dokumen keputusan
id_text.outcome: Keputusan di-draft. Tidak ada trade-off matrix formal — board meminta lebih banyak analisis.

options.label: Go with your gut — pick the cheapest proposal and explain later
options.outcome: Board approves but requests a written justification before releasing budget. Back to square one.

id_text.label: Ikuti insting — pilih proposal termurah dan jelaskan nanti
id_text.outcome: Board menyetujui tapi meminta justifikasi tertulis sebelum melepaskan anggaran. Kembali dari awal.

scenes.text: I'm walking into this meeting with clarity, not a stack of documents.

id.text: Saya masuk meeting dengan clarity, bukan dengan tumpukan dokumen.

scenes.text: The decision is still yours. Bob just made sure you didn't miss anything important.

id.text: Keputusan tetap milik Anda. Bob hanya pastikan Anda tidak kehilangan informasi penting.

scenes.text: This is what I've always needed — not more data. Less noise.

id.text: Ini yang selalu saya butuhkan — bukan lebih banyak data. Lebih sedikit kebisingan.

scenes.text:
Three proposals. One clear decision. Board meeting in 15 minutes.

The decision is always yours. I just made sure you had the right information to make it.

id.text:
Tiga proposal. Satu keputusan yang jelas. Board meeting dalam 15 menit.

Keputusan selalu milik Anda. Saya hanya memastikan Anda punya informasi yang tepat untuk membuatnya.
